executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and Enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-24 reviewed eight relevant current announcements; there is presently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
